title: REPORT on Parliament’s estimates of revenue and expenditure for the financial year 2027
part_text: Recalls that nearly two-thirds of Parliament's carbon footprint originates from the transportation of people; takes note that a significant share of Parliament’s budget, EUR 162,1 million in 2027, is spent to cover mission expenses of Members and staff; calls for a reflection of Parliament’s bodies on mission practices outside of the three working places and a revision of mission rules and practices with the overall aim to reduce the number of missions, and the associated financial and environmental costs; encourages Members to use low carbon transport alternatives and best value flight options;
